animal.herbalwitch.guide.adoption: Open this grimoire on the animal. Keeper species require %s trust and %s successful feeds; native pets require %s trust and %s feeds. Then choose Become keeper or Tame with one additional matching bait. Vanilla taming remains available.
animal.herbalwitch.guide.care: Use the existing healing salve to restore up to %s health, once per %s loaded seconds, returning its bowl. Calming powder briefly settles supported goal-selector animals for %s loaded seconds. Panic can resume afterward; attacker memory is retained.
animal.herbalwitch.guide.damage: Your successful damage removes %s of your trust and blocks feeding for %s loaded seconds. Trust never decays passively. Healing grants no trust.
animal.herbalwitch.guide.feeding: Use matching herbal bait on an awake animal to earn %s personal trust, at most once per %s loaded seconds. Holding bait attracts but never rewards trust. Vanilla food keeps its normal behavior.
animal.herbalwitch.guide.limits: Foreign pets are owner-only. Ordinary keepers grant persistence, not follow, attack, sit, home, equipment, resurrection or familiar powers. Animals remain mortal. Goats, axolotls and bats retain native Brain or flight behavior. The existing sleep vial is temporary handling, never permission or earned trust. Familiar brews remain unavailable.
animal.herbalwitch.guide.recovery: If transport fails, keep the charm and ask an operator to inspect /herbalwitch capture inspect <animal-uuid>. Reissue rotates a stored token; recover handles retained interrupted payloads for the original captor. Neither command spawns an animal or revives a released animal. Unknown saved data is preserved.
animal.herbalwitch.guide.transport: Capture supported animals only after earning 80 trust and four feeds, or when you already own them. Settle them with powder or sleep, let damage recover, dismount and unleash. Use an empty charm; release its single stored claim against a safe block face. Axolotls require a water habitat. The animal is paused while stored. Copied charms cannot duplicate it. Making a charm requires the witch workbench; using it costs no energy.

familiar.herbalwitch.guide.abilities.eff: Cats mark hostiles and visible harmful preparations; owls and rabbits find mature herbs without harvesting; wolves track one hostile; snakes sense creatures; bats sense creatures in dark spaces. Marks are private and last five seconds. Fox distraction lasts five seconds; wolf interception reduces incoming damage by twenty percent for five seconds. Snake venom follows a successful permitted bite. Garden aid makes one permitted growth attempt. Repel pushes a hostile away from the defended anchor. Players, pets, passive animals, villagers and bosses are never automatic targets.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.abilities.res: Online powers debit their owner through witch energy. Explicit charging stores five energy at a time, up to twenty, or thirty after Spirit Well. Offline Protect Home powers spend this reserve without awarding practice again. No passive refill, refund, chunk loading or offline benefits for the player.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.abilities.ret: Retrieval accepts tagged, simple loose stacks attributed to you. Public/unrelated drops: %s. Pickup delay, exclusive ownership and protection still apply. A whole stack must fit the remaining eight-item cargo capacity, or sixteen with matching gear. Payloads, containers and equipment are excluded. Never harvests, opens containers or takes a creature's held item.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.abilities.row: %s: %s energy, %s seconds recovery before equipment/preparation adjustments.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.abilities.rul: Automatic powers start off. Enable them per companion; combat powers operate only while guarding. Explicit garden, retrieval and distraction buttons select recently observed targets. Empty, denied and stale actions cost nothing. All companions share %s scan turns and %s path requests per dimension per tick.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.command.follo: Follow: keep near your owner, with checked same-dimension catch-up from an already loaded creature. No cross-dimension recreation.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.command.guard: Guard Witch: follow and defend against permitted hostiles threatening owner or familiar. Drop targets when their threat or permission ends.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.command.passi: Passive: clear work and combat, idle locally and avoid hazards. No automatic retaliation or queued powers.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.command.prote: Protect Home: defend the assigned home within its bounded radius. Offline magical defense uses prepaid reserve only.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.command.retur: Return Home: navigate to the assigned loaded home, then Stay. An unloaded, missing, obstructed or cross-dimension destination remains pending.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.command.scout: Scout: visit a few safe local waypoints and report permitted observations. Scouting alone never attacks or changes blocks.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.command.stay: Stay: hold the current anchor and rest. No automatic pursuit or attacks; escape immediate hazards locally.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.commands.limi: Follow, Guard Witch and Scout share %s mobile slots, including unloaded assignments. Guard radius %s; scout/sense radius %s. Logout or death returns mobile assignments to Stay. Recall requires a loaded creature and a safe nearby destination; it spends energy only on success.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.equipment.rul: Each familiar has one supported M7 charm slot and one matching species accessory. Use nearby detail to transfer them; native hands, offhand and Curios never add another charm slot. Cargo is collected through its own checked action. Make room first; failed transfers never scatter items. Follow the linked live workbench recipes.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.gear.bat_chim: Dark-space creature sensing recovers in eight seconds instead of ten.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.gear.cat_bell: Threat sensing recovers in eight seconds instead of ten.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.gear.fox_pouc: Cargo capacity rises from eight to sixteen items.

familiar.herbalwitch.guide.gear.rabbit_s: Garden aid recovers in twenty-four seconds instead of thirty.

familiar.herbalwitch.guide.gear.snake_ri: Venom recovers in eight seconds instead of ten.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.gear.wolf_har: Adds two armor while equipped, without stacking.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.homes.rules: Place a bed, nest or perch on solid support and use it with your grimoire to assign one compatible bond. Replacement blocks have new identities. Safe rest within two blocks heals one health per five loaded seconds, even offline; it never refills energy or revives an incapacitated familiar.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.homes.title: Homes and safe rest
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.limits: This server permits %s mobile companions and %s offline home guards per owner. Guard radius: %s blocks; sensing radius: %s. Unloaded bonds remain in your private roster but never force chunks to load.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.overview: Befriend an adult animal, then select it for Familiar Binding at your working altar and circle. Open Familiars from your grimoire; approach a loaded companion to equip it or use Powers. Binding preserves the original creature's identity and relationships.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.e: Shared fire resistance while the canonical familiar effect remains active.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.g: Adds four maximum health and two armor, without instant healing.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.h: While protecting the verified home: two armor and a thirty-tick repel recovery. No extra radius or work slots.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.m: Uses the shared M7 concealment effect; attacks still follow ordinary consent rules.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.n: Nighttime sensing and basic hostile sensing for otherwise unsensing species; never bypasses protection.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.s: Arms one emergency move up to eight blocks to checked safe loaded ground. Consumed only when the move succeeds; never revives or loads chunks.
One extra eligible care XP within the same daily cap; twenty percent lower ability cost, minimum one energy.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.v: Poison I for five seconds after a permitted hit, at most once per second. Shares the ordinary Venom Oil slot and replaces the weaker coating.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.w: Twenty percent reduction to supported fire, freezing, lightning and magic damage; never void, kill or invulnerability-bypass damage.
Use a finished product on your own active familiar within reach. No additional energy charge. Effects last %s loaded seconds; wait %s second before refreshing the same product. Effects refresh rather than stack. Bottles return once; creative use returns no container. Unloaded timers do not catch up.

Healing Salve keeps ordinary animal-care healing and its bowl return. Ordinary Venom Oil lasts sixty loaded seconds or eight permitted hits and cannot replace active Venomleaf. One shared coating prevents duplicate poison or charges. Recall preserves canonical timers; incapacitation and revival clear temporary familiar effects.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.progression.r: Bond levels use 0, 40, 100, 200 and 350 XP. Feeding and care respect animal cooldowns; nearby self-propelled travel and safe rest earn bounded rewards. Non-ritual XP is capped at ten per 24,000 loaded ticks. Each level adds one maximum health without healing. Level-three Heartwood adds four health; Spirit Well adds ten reserve capacity without refilling. Harmony grants ten XP, once per loaded day.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.recovery.admi: A quarantined bond needs a level-two operator: /herbalwitch familiar inspect <bond>, then recover <bond> only when its retained payload and receipts permit. Recovery retires old incarnations and makes revival possible; it never invents missing data, refunds ambiguous items or directly spawns a creature.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.recovery.revi: Select an incapacitated bond from the roster for Familiar Revival at the working altar and circle. A safe loaded destination is required. Successful revival returns the same identity at half maximum health in Stay, preserving reserve but clearing temporary familiar effects. Refusal or uncertainty never causes an automatic second spawn.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.recovery.rule: Lethal gameplay damage retires the creature without drops and retains its identity, relationships, equipment and cargo. Missing or unloaded entities are not proof of death. Administrative deletion never authorizes automatic resurrection.
familiar.herbalwitch.guide.species.intro: Cats and wolves require their native owner. Foxes, rabbits, ravens, owls and snakes require keeper adoption; bats use their feeding relationship without adoption. Crow is a raven appearance, sharing the same bond rules and equipment. New wild species can be found in daylight; creative eggs create unbound animals only.

grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.acquisition.0: Break grass and ferns by hand to forage. Starter herbs turn up anywhere, other herbs only in their own habitats; each herb page says where and how often.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.acquisition.1: Wild patches grow in their habitats as well. Plant seeds on farmland or a herb bed; a mature plant gives two fresh herbs and a seed when you use it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.acquisition.2: Carrying any form of a herb (seeds, fresh, dried or powdered) records it here.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.getting_start: This grimoire records what you have learned. Any grimoire opens your own knowledge, so giving one away or crafting with it shares or loses nothing.
Guides like this one are open to everyone. Herb and recipe pages fill in as you discover them, and nothing here stops you crafting, brewing or automating anything.
Begin with a starter herb: lavender, sage, mint and chamomile turn up when you break tall grass anywhere.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.heat.0: The kettle, the infusion pot, the cauldron and the still need heat from directly below: a lit hearth or stove, a lit campfire or magma. One hopper may stand between them and carry the heat.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.heat.1: The hearth and the stove burn ordinary fuel. A waterlogged vessel gets no heat.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.heat.title: Heat
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.missing_ingre: Opened from a grimoire, a stand or a bookshelf, a recipe page counts what you carry against what it needs.
Only your main inventory and offhand count: not armour, containers you carry, nearby storage or a station's own slots. Nothing is ever taken.
A station slot holds one kind of item, so different alternatives are not added together. Returned bottles and bowls are results, not ingredients.
Ingredients available means the items are there; it does not check the station's slots, its heat or room for the result.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.0: Fresh herbs dry on a drying rack into bundles. A mortar grinds bundles into powder. Powders steep with a water bottle in a kettle, or go into an infusion pot with a base and a container.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.1: Each recipe page lists exactly what its station needs, how long it takes and whether it needs heat, and links to the recipes that make its ingredients.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.2: When every ingredient of a recipe is familiar to you, the recipe records itself.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.products.0: Teas, remedies, tonics, the salve, oils and garden products each do one thing today, written on their recipe page and their tooltip.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.products.1: Some stronger preparations need a witch to make them, at the cauldron, the still or the charm workbench; anyone may use what is made.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.research.0: At a grimoire stand or a witch's bookshelf you may research a recipe when at least one of its ingredients is familiar: you carry it, or it is a form of a herb you know.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.research.1: Research is instant and free, and records the recipe only; it gives no items.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.research.2: The stand opens on the recipes you could research right now.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.stations.0: A station keeps its ingredients in its own slots, reserved while it works, and fills its output when it is done. Closing its screen leaves it working.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.stations.1: The Grimoire button on a station's screen opens this book beside it, on that station's recipes.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.teaching.0: At a stand or bookshelf, open a recipe you know and offer it to a player within eight blocks.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.teaching.1: They are told who offers what, and may accept or decline from their own grimoire within thirty seconds. Accepting records that one recipe and nothing else.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.teaching.2: An offer ends when either of you leaves, dies or changes dimension, or when the teacher closes their book.
grimoire.herbalwitch.herb.bonus: A favoured harvest has a %s%% chance of one extra herb.
grimoire.herbalwitch.herb.discovery: About 1 in %s grass breaks in its habitat turns one up.
grimoire.herbalwitch.herb.discovery.none: It is not found in grass.
grimoire.herbalwitch.herb.form.bush: A bush: harvesting by hand leaves it standing.
grimoire.herbalwitch.herb.form.crop: A crop: harvesting by hand replants it young.
grimoire.herbalwitch.herb.likes: Likes: %s (each doubles its chance, and favours a harvest).
grimoire.herbalwitch.herb.no_conditions: This world gives no growing notes for it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.hint.recipe: Carry all of its ingredients to work it out, or study one of them at a grimoire stand.
grimoire.herbalwitch.research.needs_rese: Research needs a grimoire stand or a witch's bookshelf
grimoire.herbalwitch.research.no_familia: Nothing you carry or know goes into %s
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.altar.0: A dark-wood shrine with a working table, where witches are made and energy is worked.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.altar.crafte: Crafted from two smooth stone slabs, an amethyst shard, four dark oak logs and a gold ingot.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.altar.scope: It holds nothing: offerings come from your main inventory and offhand when a ritual completes; an interrupted ritual uses nothing.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.altar.size: Two blocks wide, one deep and two high, on a sturdy floor.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.attunement.0: Practice alone: a small spend that strengthens a witch.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.attunement.c: It counts towards capacity until every threshold is reached.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.attunement.t: It costs %s energy and takes %s seconds.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.circle.0: A ring of engraved stone laid around the Witch's Altar, for the rituals that reach beyond it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.circle.altar: The altar stands inside it, one block in from the circle's left and two back, facing the same way. Using the circle opens that altar.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.circle.craft: Crafted from four smooth stone slabs, two calcite, an amethyst shard and a gold nugget.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.circle.neede: It needs a complete circle around the altar; a part out of reach pauses it, a broken part ends it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.circle.size: Five blocks square, one layer, hollow in the middle; every part needs a sturdy floor.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.familiar.bin: Matching bait, fresh sage, amethyst shard
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.familiar.hea: Fresh yarrow, fresh sage, gold ingot
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.familiar.rev: Moon essence, fresh yarrow, amethyst shard
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.familiar.spi: Amethyst shard, fresh mugwort, moon essence
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.founding.0: When no witch exists, anyone may become the first one, alone, at any altar and any hour.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.founding.ter: Confirm at the altar and stay %s seconds. You receive a grimoire (keep a slot free).
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.garden_bless: Look at an herb bed, then bless it at the altar: the beds around it are enriched, each giving one more fresh herb at its next harvest.
It reaches a square %s beds wide at that bed's height; the bed must lie within %s blocks of the altar. Enriched beds stay as they are.
It costs %s energy and takes %s seconds. The soil tonic's bottle comes back.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.home_protect: Look at an empty ward stone, then charge it at the altar, just as touching it would.
It costs %s energy and takes %s seconds, and the stone itself asks nothing more.
The stone must lie within %s blocks of the altar and be unbound or yours.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.initiation.0: A witch may make another witch, but only with consent.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.initiation.c: The one invited opens the same altar and accepts or declines; they pay nothing.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.initiation.d: An operator may designate someone; they still accept at an altar.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.initiation.t: The witch pays %s energy and the offering; both stay %s seconds. An invitation lasts %s seconds.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.meditation.0: A witch may sit with an idle altar to recover energy.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ritual.meditation.t: After %s seconds of settling it restores %s energy every %s seconds; it ends when you are full.
grimoire.herbalwitch.station.heat_source: A heat source: while lit, it heats the vessel standing on it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.bottling_b: Portions a whole mixture into four bottles or vials; gunpowder makes vials, paper adds a label. No witch needed.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.cauldron.0: A witch brews powders and a water bottle over heat into a mixture of four doses. Each batch waits for a witch to start it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.charm_work: A witch works herbs, string and gold into protective charms here.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.drying_rac: Hang fresh herbs here to dry them into bundles. It stands two blocks wide and two tall.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.hearth.0: Burns fuel to heat the kettle or infusion pot standing on it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.infusion_p: Infuses powders into a base (honey, plant oil or water) and fills a bowl or bottle.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.kettle.0: Steeps powders in a water bottle over heat into teas, remedies and tonics.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.mortar.0: Grinds dried bundles, seeds and flowers into powders and dusts.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.still.0: A witch distils essences and extracts from a water or oil base into a bottle. It stands two blocks tall over its heat.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.stove.0: A stove with two burners, each heating the vessel above it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.tools.broo: A witch binds a flying broom or repairs a worn one. Insert the old broom in the base slot; its name and remaining flight fractions are preserved.
grimoire.herbalwitch.stations.tools.wand: A witch carves a utility wand from a stick, amethyst and gold. The inputs wait until Start is pressed.
grimoire.herbalwitch.teaching.cooldown: Wait a moment before offering again
grimoire.herbalwitch.teaching.invited: %s offers to teach you %s: open your grimoire to accept or decline
grimoire.herbalwitch.teaching.no_reader: Teaching needs an open grimoire at a stand or bookshelf
grimoire.herbalwitch.teaching.recipient_: They are already considering another offer
grimoire.herbalwitch.teaching.teacher_bu: You already have an offer waiting
grimoire.herbalwitch.ui.choose: Choose a page from the index.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ui.nobody: No one is close enough to teach.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ui.open.tooltip: Open your grimoire beside this station
grimoire.herbalwitch.ui.open_for_counts: Open your grimoire to count what you carry.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ui.ready: Ingredients available (slots, heat and room not checked).
grimoire.herbalwitch.ui.scope: Counted from your inventory and offhand only.
grimoire.herbalwitch.ui.unknown: You have not discovered this yet.
The cauldron, the still and the charm workbench, and a few recipes of the mortar and the infusion pot, work only for a witch who starts each batch and pays its energy.
The cauldron brews a mixture of %s doses. The bottling bench, which needs no witch, fills that many bottles or vials from it; paper adds a label.
Energy is spent only when a batch completes, at %s percent of the listed cost on this server.

The witch who started a batch pays for it, and it only progresses while she stays within %s blocks. After she leaves the world or travels away, she presses Resume on her return; anyone may cancel a batch whose witch has left.
Fill the station, then press Start. Nothing is reserved or spent until you do, and each batch needs its own start.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.charms.0: Charms are made at the charm workbench by a witch, and anyone may wear one.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.charms.a: An amulet softens its family's blows (the undead, or spiders and pests) by %s percent, at most %s hearts.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.charms.c: A fresh charm lasts about %s minutes of wearing; it only spends while worn and alive, and breaks when spent.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.charms.l: Charms never soften a player's blow, a fall or the weather, and never strike back.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.charms.s: The protective sachet softens any mob's blow by %s percent, at most %s hearts a blow.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.charms.w: Hold a charm in your off hand, or with Curios wear it in a charm slot. Only one charm works at a time: the off hand first.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.energy.0: Witches carry energy, spent by rituals and later magic and restored by rest.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.energy.c: A new witch holds %s energy. Each practice threshold adds %s, up to %s.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.energy.e: At zero energy nothing hurts you; paid work simply waits until you recover.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.energy.p: Only completed paid work counts: recovery, refunds, cancelled work and founding do not.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.familiar: Every familiar preparation can be brewed, distilled or infused already, and the healing salve keeps its own use.
Giving them to a familiar becomes possible with familiar bonding. Until then using one does nothing and keeps it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.preparat: Anyone may use a finished preparation; only making it needs a witch.
Harmful preparations never touch other players unless the server allows it, nor another's pets or protected folk.
Binding holds a creature in place and sleep stills it until it is struck. Neither works on players or the greatest creatures, and after one ends a creature is steadfast for %s seconds.
Draughts are drunk like potions and give their bottle back. A healing draught only helps the hurt, and one waits %s seconds before the next.
Venom oil coats the blade in your off hand; thorn oil pricks whoever strikes you; repellents keep a family of creatures from choosing you.
Concealment smoke and blinding dust keep creatures from finding anyone farther than %s blocks.
A thrown vial bursts on what it hits, reaching creatures within %s blocks that it can see, nearest first. Throwing waits %s seconds between vials and never returns the glass.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.recovery: Energy returns through stillness, meditation, sleep and two kettle drinks.
Nature biomes add %s%% and a visible full moon %s%% to rest and meditation (at most %s%%).
Meditating at an altar settles for %s seconds, then restores %s energy every %s seconds.
Standing still restores %s energy every %s seconds.
A restful infusion adds %s to your next rewarded sleep, if taken within %s minutes.
A full night's sleep restores %s energy, once a day.
Energy tea restores %s energy; one cup every %s seconds.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.status.0: A witch is made, never found in a book: carrying a grimoire teaches you herbs, not witchcraft.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.status.p: Status is permanent: death does not remove it or refill energy.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.status.r: The first witch of a world founds a lineage alone at a Witch's Altar. Everyone after is initiated by a witch and must consent; an operator may also designate someone, who still has to accept.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.wards.0: A ward stone keeps chosen creatures from choosing anyone inside its boundary as prey.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.wards.ac: A witch standing by an empty stone activates it for %s energy, or charges it at an altar in a ritual circle; either way it protects for %s minutes of loaded time. It is never topped up, and quieting it gives nothing back.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.wards.bo: It reaches %s blocks each way and %s up and down. A hearth or stove within %s blocks widens it to %s; losing that focus shrinks it at once.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.wards.lo: It only works, and only spends its charge, while its land is loaded. Breaking it ends the ward; the stone comes back empty.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.wards.ne: It never harms, pushes or removes a creature and stops no damage: it only keeps them from choosing you or your guests.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.wards.ow: The first activation binds it to that witch, who alone changes it; a witch may hold %s wards.
grimoire.herbalwitch.witchcraft.wards.pr: It keeps away the undead, spiders and crawling pests, or both, as its owner chooses.
guide.herbalwitch.broom.controls: Place your broom in clear space, then use it to mount. Move with your movement keys, rise with Jump, descend with the remappable Broom Descend key, and request landing with Broom Land. Sneak dismounts. Only the owner may ride or sneak-use a grounded broom to pack it; packing needs an empty inventory slot.
guide.herbalwitch.broom.lifecycle: Exhaustion, disallowed flight or worn-out condition forces a free descent. Unloaded terrain stops movement. Logout and dimension travel leave the broom behind; restart never resumes controls. A real airborne dismount grants up to %s seconds of protection against one ordinary fall, not fire or the void.
guide.herbalwitch.broom.obtain: Craft a broom stand, then use its recipe pages to bind a broom or repair a worn one. A witch must press Start and attend the work. Repair preserves the broom?s name and accumulated flight fractions.
guide.herbalwitch.broom.rules: Current rules: horizontal speed %s blocks/s, vertical speed %s blocks/s, upkeep %s energy/s, one wear per %s flying ticks, %s total condition. Hovering wears the broom. Passive upkeep grants no practice.
guide.herbalwitch.broom.title: Broom flight and care
guide.herbalwitch.shop.buying.0: Anyone may browse an open shop at its register, a linked counter or a display, and buy one lot at a time with emeralds from their inventory.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.buying.1: If an offer changes while you look, the purchase is refused rather than charged differently.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.buying.limits: Stand within %s blocks and see the fixture. Your inventory must have room; nothing is dropped and no change is given.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.buying.title: Buying
guide.herbalwitch.shop.metadata.0: What a buyer gets is exactly what was stocked: water purity, bottle labels and a charm's used charge are kept and shown.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.metadata.1: Stacks with other data, nested inventories, creature tokens and four-dose mixtures cannot be sold.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.metadata.title: Exact goods
guide.herbalwitch.shop.offline.0: A shop sells only while its register is loaded. Nothing sells while you are away from an unloaded shop, and nothing catches up later.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.offline.1: Linked displays show sold out while the register is unloaded.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.offline.title: Unloaded shops
guide.herbalwitch.shop.orders.0: At an order board, customers request a product, quantity and the most they will pay per lot. Nothing is paid or promised.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.orders.1: The owner can decline a request or suggest an existing offer; the customer still buys at the current price.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.orders.limits: %1$s active requests per customer and %2$s per shop; a request lasts %3$s economy windows; wait %4$s seconds between requests.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.orders.title: Requests
guide.herbalwitch.shop.pricing.0: An offer sells one lot of an exact product for whole emeralds, taken from a stock sample.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.pricing.1: Changing an offer makes a new version; anyone who saw the old one is asked to look again.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.pricing.limits: Up to %1$s offers, priced %2$s to %3$s emeralds, lots up to %4$s (one stack).
guide.herbalwitch.shop.pricing.title: Offers and prices
guide.herbalwitch.shop.proceeds.0: Sales add emeralds to the shop's proceeds; only the owner can take them out.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.proceeds.1: The ledger is a record for you, not a recovery journal.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.proceeds.limits: Proceeds hold up to %1$s emeralds. The ledger keeps the latest %2$s events for the owner alone.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.proceeds.title: Proceeds and ledger
guide.herbalwitch.shop.recovery.0: Every transfer is saved in steps. If a server stops in the middle, the shop waits for proof before settling it.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.recovery.1: An unresolved transfer shows its identifier. An operator can reconcile it from proof or discard it; nothing is ever granted twice.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.recovery.title: Interrupted transfers
guide.herbalwitch.shop.setup.0: Set a shop register on an apothecary counter. An initiated witch names the shop from it; the shop starts closed.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.setup.1: Removing the register detaches the shop; its stock and proceeds stay safe until you reconnect it from a new register.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.setup.limits: A witch may keep %1$s shops. Up to %2$s more counters and %3$s displays or boards can be linked, all within %4$s blocks of the register.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.setup.title: Keeping a shop
guide.herbalwitch.shop.stocking.0: Stock moves only through the register: choose a stack in your main inventory or hotbar and how many to move.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.stocking.1: Shop shelves and jars only show offers; ordinary furniture shelves keep their own storage.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.stocking.limits: A shop holds %s stock slots. Hoppers, pipes and familiars cannot reach it.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.stocking.title: Stocking
guide.herbalwitch.shop.villagers.0: Owners may let nearby adult villagers buy from an open, loaded shop. They walk to the register; nothing is simulated.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.villagers.1: The preparation is used up as demand. Villagers gain no trades, experience or discounts from it.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.villagers.limits: Villagers buy a %1$s-item lot priced at %2$s emerald. Each window the world spends at most %3$s, one owner %4$s, one shop %5$s, one villager %6$s purchases; a window lasts %7$s days of running time; customers come from within %8$s blocks.
guide.herbalwitch.shop.villagers.title: Villager customers
guide.herbalwitch.wand.cost: Current successful-action price: %s energy. Refused or unchanged targets cost nothing.
guide.herbalwitch.wand.delegation: Focus opens existing ritual or ward controls; offerings, consent, ownership, duration and costs still apply. Familiar mode opens your existing roster or a nearby owned familiar?s card. Ordinary commands are free; Recall retains its existing energy cost, cooldown and safe-location rules. No mode grants access to foreign inventories or unloaded terrain.
guide.herbalwitch.wand.obtain: Carve a wand at the wand bench. Hold it and open the remappable Wand Choose Utility control (V by default); selecting does not cast. Use the selected utility with either hand. Casting while mounted on a broom is refused.
guide.herbalwitch.wand.rules: Current limits: reach %s blocks (also limited by your interaction reach), %s ticks between successful local actions, at most %s dropped items inspected and %s stacks accepted within radius %s. Both hands and all wand copies share the cooldown.
guide.herbalwitch.wand.title: Wand utilities
